DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メモでは八時、画面では九時となっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your note says eight, but the screen says nine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メモは腕時計を見て書きました。どちらが正しいかまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時刻の情報源と不明点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the note using my wristwatch. I still don't know which time is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State where the times came from and what is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面を後から変更しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you change the screen later?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。そのまま保存しました。端末の時刻設定は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存画面の未改変を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I saved it as it was. I haven't checked the device's time settings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not alter the saved screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の記録は残してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 数字をそろえて書き換えず、使った時計をそれぞれ付記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時計の出所を注記して原記録を守る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't rewrite the numbers to match. I'll note which clock I used for each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Preserve the original records by noting the source of each time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を見た時刻と保存した時刻は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you view the content and save it at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し違います。見た後、家に戻って保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閲覧と保存の時点を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not quite. After viewing it, I went home and saved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the viewing time from the saving time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順序も書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write down that sequence too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見る、メモする、保存するという順番で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行動順で経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the sequence: viewing, making a note, then saving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain what happened in the order of your actions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、時刻の不一致を残したまま経緯を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll hear what happened while leaving the conflicting times on record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 三個のお荷物をお送りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending three packages, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。控えの番号と相手を後で対応させたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えと届け先の対応を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to match the receipt numbers to the recipients later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to match the receipts to the destinations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お荷物ごとに控えが出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You will get a receipt for each package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、一個ずつ渡して、受け取った控えに自分の一覧の印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一件ずつ渡し控えを識別すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll hand them over one at a time and mark each receipt with the corresponding symbol from my list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to hand over one package at a time and identify each receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱そのものの宛名も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the address on each box itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は姉、次は友人、最後は会社です。宛名の順も合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三件の順と宛名を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The first is for my older sister, the next for a friend, and the last for my company. The addresses are in the right order too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the order and addresses of all three packages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えはその順でお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll return the receipts in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。番号を一覧へ写したら、控えにも同じ印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号一覧と控えの印をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. After copying the numbers to my list, I'll put the same marks on the receipts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use matching marks on the number list and the receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相手へ知らせる際は、一件ずつ見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When notifying the recipients, please check each one again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉に友人の番号を送らないよう、宛先と番号をもう一度照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手へ送る番号を再照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the recipient and number once more so I don't send my friend's number to my sister.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Recheck the numbers you will send to the recipients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、最初の箱から受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take the first box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 控えのどの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the receipt do you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に支払ったことを伝えたいんですが、この紙全体を写真にしていいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの共有範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell my family I've paid, but I'm unsure whether to photograph this entire paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much of the receipt to share. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の情報も含まれていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日付と金額だけ伝えれば、家族には用件が分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族に必要な情報を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family will understand if I tell them just the date and amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Limit the information to what your family needs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な内容に絞って共有できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can share only the necessary details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取引の表示も確認したいです。受付と完了は違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付と完了表示の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like to check the transaction status. Is accepted different from completed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between accepted and completed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示の意味は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person in charge what the status means.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認前には「完了した」と伝えず、今の表示をそのまま説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の完了を断定しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before it's confirmed, I won't say it's completed. I'll describe the current status exactly as shown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to assert completion before it is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えはご自身で保管してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。意味を確認してから、必要な内容だけ家族に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原控えを保管し必要情報だけ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After checking what it means, I'll tell my family only what they need to know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original receipt and share only necessary information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、表示について確認しましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日はこの時間に値引きされていたので、今日も待てば安くなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日の値引きから当日予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was discounted at this time yesterday. Will it get cheaper today too if I wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about today's plans based on yesterday's discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 毎回同じ時刻とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The time is not always the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、昨日のことだけで今日の値段は決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時刻が保証されないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then yesterday's discount alone doesn't tell us today's price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the timing is not guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の商品に付いた表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the label attached to the item now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この一個は今の表示で買います。待つことはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現時点の価格で購入を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll buy this one at its current marked price. I'll stop waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to buy at the current price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ品が二つありますが、表示は別に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are two of the same item, but please check their labels separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらには違うシールがあります。買う一個の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同品でも個別表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one has a different sticker. I'll check the label on the one I'm buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check individual labels even on identical items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計でもその商品をご提示ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please present that item at the checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一個だけかごに入れます。もう一つは棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入する一個を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put only this one in my basket. I'll put the other back on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the single item you are buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その商品の表示で会計へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then proceed to checkout at the price marked on that item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集めた葉を全部使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you use all the leaves you collected?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 濡れた葉も混じっています。このまま貼るとどうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 湿った素材の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Some wet leaves are mixed in. What happens if I glue them on as they are?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle damp materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、乾いたものと分けてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's separate them from the dry ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触って確かめて、乾いた三枚だけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乾いた葉だけを選別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll feel them to check and choose only three dry leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Select only dry leaves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare the colors too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑を一枚、茶色を二枚にして、並び方を変えてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と枚数の組合せを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use one green and two brown leaves and try arranging them differently.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide on a combination of colors and quantities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ貼らずに置いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please lay them out without gluing them yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸く並べるより、斜めのほうが好きです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貼る前に配置を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I like the diagonal arrangement better than the circular one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare arrangements before gluing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残りの葉はどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: What will you do with the remaining leaves?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 工作用に残す分を相談して、不要な分は勝手に散らさず片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余材の処理を係と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask which ones to keep for crafts and tidy up the unwanted ones without scattering them around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult the staff about handling leftover materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その配置で貼り、残りは係と片付けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then glue them in that arrangement and tidy up the rest with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の荷物を返す予定ですが、別の人が受け取るとメッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 第三者受取の曖昧な連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm supposed to return my friend's belongings, but I got a message saying someone else will collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the unclear message about collection by a third party. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取る方の名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the collector's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「いつもの人」とだけ書いてあります。これでは渡せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人が特定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only says “the usual person.” I can't hand them over on that basis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot identify the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人に直接確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check directly with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人へ電話します。知らない人に荷物の中身は言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ確認し中身を他者に話さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll call my friend. I'll avoid telling strangers what's inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the owner and do not tell others what is inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ間、荷物はお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the belongings with you while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話がつながりました。友人自身が戻って受け取るそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が戻るとの返答を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I got through. My friend says they'll come back and collect them personally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the reply that the owner will return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その方をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please wait for your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人に返します。知らない人への受け渡しはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人への返却だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return them to my friend personally. I won't hand them to a stranger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to return the belongings only to their owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内所の入口を空けて、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the information desk entrance clear and wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の質問はこちらで受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We take questions about the exhibition here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供が書いた質問ですが、私が言い換えたら難しくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人の言い換えで難しくなったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is a question my child wrote, but my rewording made it complicated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an adult's rewording made the question harder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元はどんな質問でしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「なぜ昔の道は曲がっているの」です。今の紙には専門的な言葉を足してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の質問と追加語を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: “Why are old roads crooked?” I added technical words to the version on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the original question and explain the added wording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の疑問でも大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The original question is perfectly fine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、子供の言葉へ戻します。知りたいのは道の形の理由です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の疑問へ表現を戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll go back to my child's words. They want to know why the roads have that shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Restore wording that reflects the child's own question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明を受ける方法も選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also choose how to receive the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供が図を見ると分かりやすいので、図がある資料を紹介してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図のある説明資料を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My child finds diagrams easier to understand, so I'd like you to recommend material with diagrams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for explanatory material with diagrams. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の有無を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge whether we have any.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。子供には、まだ答えが出たのではなく資料を探していると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答未確定の状態を子供へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll tell my child that we're still looking for material, rather than that we already have an answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the child the answer has not yet been established. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の質問と資料のご希望を担当へ届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the original question and your request for materials to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この一覧の薬を今も使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you still using the medicines on this list?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 全部ではありません。この一つは先週から使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現用と中止薬の混在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not all of them. I haven't used this one since last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the list contains both current and discontinued medicines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中止した日を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the date you stopped?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金曜日です。名前を消すだけでなく、日付を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中止日を注記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Friday. I'd like to add the date, rather than just erase the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Note the discontinuation date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中止の経緯も担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also explain to the person in charge why it was discontinued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の診察で指示を受けました。自分だけでやめたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中止の指示元を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was instructed to stop at my previous appointment. I didn't stop on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain who instructed you to stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の薬も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check your current medicines too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今使う二つを別の欄へ写して、元の一覧は残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現用薬を区分し旧一覧を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll copy the two I'm using now into a separate section and keep the original list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the current medicines and retain the old list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実物や薬の情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have the medicines or information about them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋を持っています。名称と量は袋を見て説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬袋で名称と量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the medicine bags. I'll look at them to explain the names and doses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the medicine bags to give the names and doses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、一覧と袋を一緒に担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please show both the list and bags to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様の質問カードをお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your child's question card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ちょっと待ってください。「自転車で歩く」とあって、意味を聞いてから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードの曖昧な表現を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait a moment. It says “walk by bicycle,” and I'd like to ask what that means before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the ambiguous wording on the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子様は今こちらにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自転車を押して歩く場合のことだそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人へ確認した意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They say they mean walking while pushing a bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the intention you checked with the child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その言葉を付け加えると伝わりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Adding those words will make it clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子供に「押して歩く」と書き足してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子供自身に表現を補ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll have my child add “pushing it while walking.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Have the child add to their own wording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前を読み上げてよいかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check whether we may read out their name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質問は読んで構いませんが、名前は読まないでほしいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問の公開と名前の公開を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say you may read the question, but they don't want their name read out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish permission to publish the question from permission to publish the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 匿名の質問として受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll take it as an anonymous question.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直したカードを子供と見ました。こちらをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人と確認したカードを渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: My child and I have checked the corrected card. Please take this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the card checked with the child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 押して歩く場合の匿名の質問としてお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take this as an anonymous question about walking while pushing a bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be sending this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。中に返信用封筒も入れます。切手の確認は二つ別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往路と返信の料金確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll include a return envelope too. Do we check the stamps for the two separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about checking outbound and return postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外に送る分と、返信で送る分は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check the outgoing item and the return item separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返信には一枚の書類を入れてもらう予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信予定の中身を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I expect them to put one document in the return envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the expected return contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信側の封筒と予定の中身も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the return envelope and its expected contents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ大きさの紙を持ってきました。見本として使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身の見本を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought paper of the same size. Can you use it as a sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present a sample of the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定の重さを考える手がかりにはなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It can help us estimate the expected weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信に何が入るか相手にも確認してから、切手を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手へ返信内容を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check with the recipient what will be in the reply before deciding on the stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm the return contents with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 外の封筒は、全部入れた後に量ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll weigh the outer envelope after everything is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。返信の準備が済んでから、外側を封します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信準備後に外側を封する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll seal the outer envelope after preparing the return envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Seal the outer envelope after preparing the return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二つの発送条件を順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the conditions for both mailings in order.
